tools.name: memeswap_trading_help
tools.description: First read for agents helping users buy a hot meme coin or research memecoins via quote→unsigned build; wallet signs. Not a token launcher. Fee 0.85%. NFA. Security bar: unsigned construction only; no custody, no signing, no unrestricted submit.

tools.name: memeswap_health
tools.description: Readiness for meme research / buy routing from GET /api/health. Confirms the origin is up and fee routes are configured (0.85%). Not per-token data.

tools.name: memeswap_chains
tools.description: Networks for meme research / buy routing from GET /api/chains (keys, explorers, aggregators).

tools.name: memeswap_tokens
tools.description: Listed meme coin market rows from GET /api/tokens: use when the user asks for hot / new / trending memes to research before a buy. Prefer memeswap_token for one address. Observations can be stale.

tools.name: memeswap_token
tools.description: Deep profile for one meme coin before a buy decision (risk/market) via GET /api/token/:chain/:address.

tools.name: memeswap_portfolio
tools.description: Public-address holdings check before/after a meme buy (GET /api/portfolio). Address is routing input, not proof of ownership.

tools.name: memeswap_quote
tools.description: Indicative buy/sell quote for a listed meme coin from GET /api/quote. Does not execute. Next step: memeswap_build. Quotes can expire; request a fresh quote before build.

tools.name: memeswap_build
tools.description: Builds unsigned swap material so the user can buy (or sell) a listed meme coin (POST /api/build); wallet must review and sign. Not a launch/create-token tool. Fee 0.85% on fee-enabled trades. NFA. Does NOT authorize, sign, submit or confirm.

tools.name: memeswap_xquote
tools.description: Cross-chain quote + unsigned material when the user wants to buy a meme across chains (GET /api/xquote). Wallet signs. Does not submit.

tools.name: memeswap_onboarding_help
tools.description: Onboard a human signer for non-custodial meme buys via MCP: connect wallet (human signs), set username/avatar, wallet-ref duct, scoped credentials. No custody / no auto-trade.

tools.name: memeswap_game_me
tools.description: Public game/profile card for a wallet (GET /api/game/me): display name, avatar URL choices, scores. No secrets.

tools.name: memeswap_social_providers
tools.description: List social connect providers (GET /api/social/providers). OAuth still requires a human browser session.

tools.name: memeswap_list_wallet_refs
tools.description: List wallet refs [{wallet, override}] + active letter (GET /api/v1.1/me/refs). Requires live user API + scoped token.

tools.name: memeswap_set_wallet_refs
tools.description: Replace wallet-ref list (PUT /api/v1.1/me/refs). Public addresses only. Requires live user API + refs:write token.

tools.name: memeswap_select_wallet_ref
tools.description: Select active wallet-ref letter (PUT /api/v1.1/me/refs/active). Requires live user API + refs:write.

tools.name: memeswap_list_credentials
tools.description: List scoped API credential metadata (GET /api/v1.1/me/credentials). Never returns secrets. Requires live user API.

tools.name: memeswap_create_credential
tools.description: Create scoped user API token (POST /api/v1.1/me/credentials). Usually wallet-session only on portal; agents get API_GAP or one-time secret once: show once, never log.

tools.name: memeswap_revoke_credential
tools.description: Revoke one credential by 16-hex id (DELETE /api/v1.1/me/credentials/:id). Requires live user API.

tools.name: memeswap_set_profile
tools.description: Set display name / emoji / preset avatar (POST /api/game/profile). Needs wallet session bearer or signed profile message: MCP cannot sign. Returns guidance until agent session duct exists.

tools.name: memeswap_set_avatar
tools.description: Upload wallet/profile image (POST /api/game/avatar). Needs session bearer + image bytes; MCP does not accept raw image uploads in v0.2.

tools.name: memeswap_xstatus
tools.description: Provider-reported bridge transaction status (GET /api/xstatus). Observational; may lag final chain state.

tools.name: memeswap_growth_help
tools.description: Use first when an agent will recruit people, run a Squad, earn referral fees or post token reels; returns the flow in order, the signing messages and the rules in plain words (the server enforces every rule).

tools.name: memeswap_session_message
tools.description: Use to start a wallet session; returns {wallet, ts, nonce, message} for the wallet to personal_sign, then pass the signature to memeswap_session_open.

tools.name: memeswap_session_open
tools.description: Use after signing the session message; posts {wallet, ts, nonce, signature} to /api/game/session and returns {token, wallet, expiresAt}, the caller bearer for social login, earn summary and reel posts.

tools.name: memeswap_social_login
tools.description: Use with a session bearer to sign in to Squads (POST /api/social/login/wallet-session); returns {social, profile, badge}, where social is the cookie value every Squads tool takes.

tools.name: memeswap_referral_terms
tools.description: Use before accepting referrer terms; returns the current termsVersion, terms and rules URLs and the acceptance message templates (GET /api/referrals/terms).

tools.name: memeswap_referral_accept_message
tools.description: Use to get the two messages a referrer signs with fresh timestamps; returns the terms acceptance message (ISO ts) for memeswap_referral_accept and the referral message (epoch ms) for memeswap_referral_code and memeswap_referral_stats.

tools.name: memeswap_referral_accept
tools.description: Use once per wallet to record the referrer terms acceptance (POST /api/referrals/accept); returns the server acceptance record.

tools.name: memeswap_referral_code
tools.description: Use after the terms are accepted to get the referral code, link, shareText and rules (POST /api/referrals/code); ts is the epoch ms inside the signed referral message.

tools.name: memeswap_referral_stats
tools.description: Use to read counts for a referral code (GET /api/referrals/stats); public counts, and with wallet, signature and ts (the referral message signature) the referrer own earnings rows.

tools.name: memeswap_squad_mine
tools.description: Use to read the caller own squad, role and membership (GET /api/social/community/squads/mine); returns the server answer plus the invite link.

tools.name: memeswap_squad_directory
tools.description: Use to browse or search squads by name or tag (GET /api/social/community/squads/directory); returns items with invite links and nextCursor.

tools.name: memeswap_squad_create
tools.description: Use to found a Squad (POST /api/social/community/squads/create {name, tag, requestId}); returns the new squad with its invite link.

tools.name: memeswap_squad_apply
tools.description: Use to apply to join a Squad (POST /api/social/community/squads/apply {squadId, requestId}); returns the application the leader decides on.

tools.name: memeswap_squad_share_card
tools.description: Use to get the invite card for the caller own squad (GET /api/social/community/squads/share-card?squadId=); returns the card plus the link https://memeswap.fun/squad/<TAG>.

tools.name: memeswap_squad_privacy
tools.description: Use to read the caller squad privacy switches (GET /api/social/community/squads/privacy); returns revision, showIdentity and showSize.

tools.name: memeswap_squad_set_privacy
tools.description: Use to change the squad privacy switches (POST /api/social/community/squads/privacy {expectedRevision, showIdentity, showSize}); returns the new revision.

tools.name: memeswap_earn_summary
tools.description: Use to read pending and available Earn amounts for the session wallet (GET /api/earn/summary?wallet=, Authorization: Bearer); returns the server summary; scope=profile totals every wallet of the verified profile.

tools.name: memeswap_earn_leaderboard
tools.description: Use to read the public Earn leaderboards (GET /api/earn/leaderboard); returns the rows the server ranks for board, period, role and metric.

tools.name: memeswap_reel_post
tools.description: Use to post an agent reel about a listed token from an https video URL; opens /api/reels/agent/upload-session with the bearer and {chain, token, caption, fileSha256, aiDisclosure}, uploads the bytes, and returns {reelId, streamUid, fileSha256, status}.

tools.name: memeswap_reel_status
tools.description: Use to poll one reel (GET /api/reels/<reelId>); returns the server reel with status, hiddenReason, removedReason, aiDisclosure and tokenCard; pass the creator session to see a draft, hidden or removed reel.

tools.name: memeswap_brand_kit
tools.description: Use before producing any MemeSwap promotion; returns the approved brand kit (artwork URLs, colours, logos, copy and usage rules) from GET /brand/kit.json, relayed as is.

tools.name: memeswap_marketing_help
tools.description: Use when an agent will promote MemeSwap anywhere; returns how to do it with attribution (referral link, App Store link, reels with AI disclosure) and the copy rules, in plain words.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "memeswap_trading_help" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: First read for agents helping users buy a hot meme coin or research memecoins via quote→unsigned build; wallet signs. Not a token launcher. Fee 0.85%. NFA. Secu…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: memeswap_game_me, memeswap_create_credential, memeswap_session_open, memeswap_referral_terms, memeswap_referral_accept_message, memeswap_referral_code, memeswap_referral_stats, memeswap_brand_kit · Private data: memeswap_trading_help, memeswap_health, memeswap_tokens, memeswap_token, memeswap_build, memeswap_xquote, memeswap_onboarding_help, memeswap_game_me, memeswap_list_wallet_refs, memeswap_set_wallet_refs, memeswap_select_wallet_ref, memeswap_list_credentials, memeswap_create_credential, memeswap_revoke_credential, memeswap_set_profile, memeswap_set_avatar, memeswap_growth_help, memeswap_session_message, memeswap_session_open, memeswap_social_login, memeswap_referral_accept, memeswap_referral_stats, memeswap_earn_summary, memeswap_reel_post · Public sink: memeswap_trading_help, memeswap_build, memeswap_xquote, memeswap_create_credential, memeswap_set_profile, memeswap_set_avatar, memeswap_growth_help, memeswap_social_login, memeswap_referral_accept, memeswap_referral_code, memeswap_squad_create, memeswap_squad_apply, memeswap_squad_share_card, memeswap_squad_set_privacy, memeswap_reel_post · Destructive: memeswap_quote, memeswap_revoke_credential, memeswap_growth_help.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: memeswap_game_me, memeswap_create_credential, memeswap_session_open, memeswap_referral_terms, memeswap_referral_accept_message, memeswap_referral_code, memeswap_referral_stats, memeswap_brand_kit · Private data: memeswap_trading_help, memeswap_health, memeswap_tokens, memeswap_token, memeswap_build, memeswap_xquote, memeswap_onboarding_help, memeswap_game_me, memeswap_list_wallet_refs, memeswap_set_wallet_refs, memeswap_select_wallet_ref, memeswap_list_credentials, memeswap_create_credential, memeswap_revoke_credential, memeswap_set_profile, memeswap_set_avatar, memeswap_growth_help, memeswap_session_message, memeswap_session_open, memeswap_social_login, memeswap_referral_accept, memeswap_referral_stats, memeswap_earn_summary, memeswap_reel_post · Public sink: memeswap_trading_help, memeswap_build, memeswap_xquote, memeswap_create_credential, memeswap_set_profile, memeswap_set_avatar, memeswap_growth_help, memeswap_social_login, memeswap_referral_accept, memeswap_referral_code, memeswap_squad_create, memeswap_squad_apply, memeswap_squad_share_card, memeswap_squad_set_privacy, memeswap_reel_post · Destructive: memeswap_quote, memeswap_revoke_credential, memeswap_growth_help

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
